title: Checkup and cleaning
visits: 50~Hygiene visit: cleaning, polishing and gum measurements, with x-rays once a year|15~The dentist checks every tooth, your bite and the soft tissue, at the same appointment
feel_note: Scraping and a bit of pressure. Most people find the polish the noisiest part.
summary: A hygiene visit and an exam in one appointment: cleaning, gum measurements, x-rays when they are due, and a check of every tooth.
body:
Twice a year, most patients spend about an hour with us. A hygienist cleans and polishes, measures the gum pockets around each tooth, and takes x-rays if it has been a year. Then a dentist looks at every tooth on the chart and talks you through anything worth watching.

If nothing needs doing, you leave with a date for your next visit. If something does, you leave with a written plan and an estimate before anything is booked.

title: Sealants
visits: 30~Clean, dry and paint a thin coating into the grooves of each molar, then set it with a blue light
feel_note: Nothing at all. It tastes a little sour and takes a few minutes per tooth.
summary: A thin coating painted into the deep grooves of the back teeth, usually soon after they come in at six and twelve.
body:
The chewing surfaces of molars have grooves deeper than a toothbrush bristle. A sealant fills them so food and bacteria cannot settle there.

We check sealants at every checkup and top them up if a corner has worn.

title: Fluoride varnish
visits: 5~Painted onto the teeth at the end of a checkup
feel_note: Sticky and slightly sweet. No eating for thirty minutes afterwards.
summary: A quick coat of fluoride painted on at the end of a checkup to strengthen the enamel.
body: Most useful for children, and for adults with dry mouth or a lot of fillings.

title: Tooth-colored filling
visits: 45~Numb the tooth, remove the decay, then build the tooth back up in layers of composite and shape the bite
feel_note: You feel pressure and hear the drill, but not pain. Numbness lasts two to three hours.
lasts: Seven to ten years or longer
summary: A cavity is cleaned out and filled with composite that matches the color of the tooth.
body:
Small fillings take about half an hour. Larger ones on molars can take closer to an hour.

We use tooth-colored composite only. If a cavity is too large for a filling to hold, we will talk about a crown instead.

title: Crown
visits: 90~Shape the tooth, take a 3D scan and fit a temporary crown|30~Two weeks later: remove the temporary and bond the final crown
feel_note: Like a long filling. The gum around the tooth can be tender for a day or two.
summary: A cap that covers a tooth that is cracked, heavily filled or treated with a root canal.
body:
We scan instead of taking impressions with putty. The scan goes to a dental lab, and the crown comes back in about two weeks.

Until then you wear a temporary crown, which is shaped to look right but is not as strong.

title: Root canal
visits: 90~Numb the tooth, clean out the infected nerve, shape and seal the canals|60~A few weeks later: build up the tooth and prepare it for a crown
feel_note: Most people say it feels like a long filling. The tooth may ache for a few days.
lasts: For the life of the tooth, with a crown on top
summary: Treatment for a tooth whose nerve is infected or inflamed, so the tooth can be kept instead of removed.
body:
Front teeth have one canal; molars usually have three or four, so they take longer.

After a root canal, a back tooth is more brittle, so we almost always recommend a crown.

title: Deep cleaning
teeth_label: Every tooth, one side at a time
visits: 75~Right side, upper and lower: clean below the gumline and smooth the root surfaces|75~Left side, upper and lower|45~Six weeks later: measure the gums again
feel_note: The gums are numbed. They may feel tender and look a little red for a few days.
lasts: Followed by cleanings every three to four months
summary: Cleaning below the gumline for gum disease, done in two visits with a recheck six weeks later.
body: When gum pockets measure five millimeters or deeper, a regular cleaning cannot reach the bottom. A deep cleaning does, one side of the mouth at a time.

title: Night guard
visits: 20~Take a 3D scan of your teeth|15~Two weeks later: fit and adjust the guard
feel_note: Nothing. The guard feels bulky for the first few nights.
recovery: A few nights to get used to it
summary: A custom guard you wear at night if you grind or clench your teeth.
body: Grinding usually shows up first as flat, worn edges on the canines. A night guard takes the load instead of your teeth.

title: Whitening
teeth_label: The teeth that show when you smile
visits: 30~Scan for custom trays and a shade check|20~Fit the trays and show you how to use the gel at home
feel_note: Some people get short, sharp twinges of sensitivity in the first few days.
summary: Custom trays and whitening gel you use at home over two weeks.
body:
We do not offer in-office whitening. Trays at home give a more even result with less sensitivity.

Fillings and crowns do not whiten, so we check them first.

title: Bonding
visits: 60~Shape tooth-colored composite onto chipped or uneven edges and polish it
feel_note: Nothing. No numbing needed for most bonding.
summary: Tooth-colored composite shaped onto chipped, worn or uneven front teeth in one visit.
body: Bonding is a good fit for small chips and gaps. For larger changes in shape or color, veneers or crowns last longer.

title: Clear aligners
visits: 45~Scan, photos and a plan you can see before you decide|20~Fit the first aligners and attachments|15~Check every eight weeks until the last aligner
feel_note: Each new aligner feels tight for a day or two.
recovery: A day or two with each new aligner
lasts: Wear a retainer at night afterwards
summary: Clear, removable aligners that straighten teeth over six to eighteen months.
body: Dr. Vartanian plans each case from a 3D scan. You see the planned result before you agree to anything.

title: Wisdom tooth removal
visits: 30~Consult and a panoramic x-ray|60~Remove the teeth, usually all on one side or all four|15~One week later: a short check
feel_note: You will not feel pain during it. Expect swelling and soreness for two to four days.
numbing: Local anesthetic, with sedation if you would like it
summary: Removal of wisdom teeth that are stuck, crowded or causing problems.
body: Not every wisdom tooth needs to come out. If yours are upright and easy to clean, we watch them at each checkup instead.

title: Dental implant
teeth_label: Any missing tooth except wisdom teeth
visits: 45~Consult and a 3D scan of the jaw|90~Place the implant post|30~Three months later: check the healing|45~Fit the final crown
feel_note: Usually less sore than people expect. Most patients take two days off.
numbing: Local anesthetic, with sedation if you would like it
summary: A titanium post that replaces the root of a missing tooth, with a crown on top.
body: The post needs about three months to bond with the jaw before the crown goes on. A temporary tooth fills the gap until then.

title: Simple extraction
teeth_label: Any tooth that cannot be saved
visits: 40~Numb the tooth and remove it, then place gauze to stop the bleeding
feel_note: Pressure, not pain. The socket is sore for a few days.
summary: Removal of a tooth that cannot be repaired.
body: We always talk through what will fill the gap before we remove a tooth.

title: Toothache or broken tooth
visits: 45~Same-day exam, an x-ray of the tooth and relief: a temporary filling, a smoothed edge or a plan
feel_note: Depends on the problem. The aim of this visit is to stop the pain.
lasts: A first visit, then a plan
summary: A same-day visit for pain, swelling or a broken tooth, for patients of the practice and anyone else in Tansey Ford.
body: Call before nine and we will see you that day. Out of hours, the answerphone gives the number of the on-call dentist.
